verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships its own documented `omarchy` CLI for scripting system control and configuration (e.g. `omarchy reminder 7 'Tea ready'`, `omarchy windows key`). It also ships preinstalled agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code) with skills for automating customization work. However, the evidence never describes a dedicated automation tool for defining recurring or triggered workflows to eliminate repetitive tasks. Automation is only implied through the scriptable CLI and AI agents. Missing for 10: a documented first-party automation/macro or task-scheduling tool, examples of automating repetitive workflows, CLI command coverage details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
